title: pulicaria crispa
intro: Pulicaria crispa, commonly known as Ulaji or Wild Artichoke, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria crispa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
